scenario.summary: Guest opens a simple product's PDP and verifies the You May Also Like and Frequently Bought sections: each card's details are visible, names and prices match the linked products, the highlight badges and the remaining-highlights count are shown.
steps: Open the webstore, search the product SKU and open its PDP
Scroll to You May Also Like: title and card details visible; names and prices; Free Shipping / WaterSense / BIO badges; '+N' remaining highlights
Scroll to Frequently Bought: card details visible; names and prices; badges; '+N' remaining highlights
assertions: You May Also Like cards show the product's YouMayAlsoLike links (name, price)
Frequently Bought cards show the product's FrequentlyBought links (name, price)
Free Shipping, WaterSense and BIO Certified badges are visible; remaining highlights count is 1 in both sections
evidence: Independent method (no dependsOn); linked manual cases Z10-TC-8694, 8695, 8696, 8699, 8703, 8707, 8711 are in the class comment, not in the scan.

Needs as the Playwright pdp add-to-cart entry: product + PRODUCT_LINKED_PRODUCTS for FrequentlyBought and YouMayAlsoLike linked to @product.productId (the resolver resolves the product first and re-picks it when it has no links, core 0.15.0). minLinked left out (at least one): the method checks whatever cards the PDP shows.

Product key PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITH_REQUIRED_ADDON {minRequiredAddOns 1, quantityUsed 1 (nothing is added)}: chosen so the sheet product z-2420005 (tda rows: one Required DropDown add-on group; 3 YouMayAlsoLike, 2 FrequentlyBought links) qualifies as the preferred record and both link needs resolve; it returns productId, which PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITH_ADDON_IN_STOCK does not. The required add-on is NOT something this method needs (it adds nothing to the cart). First draft used PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK: z-2420005 fails its requiredAddOnCount = 0 rule and readiness bound the fallback product 950, which has no FrequentlyBought links (GAP ZERO_ROWS). Reviewer choice: keep this key, or go back to PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK and rely on the resolver re-picking the parent (core 0.15.0) - readiness does not show whether any of its rows has both link types.

Not scanned: TestData.getHashMap tables are not in the scan. youMayAlsoLikeProduct / youMayAlsoLikeProductPrice / frequentlyBoughtProduct / frequentlyBoughtProductPrice (ProductName0..n, ProductPrice0..n) compare every card's name and price. They are values of this method's needs and must come from the resolved record when the class is migrated (youMayAlsoLike / frequentlyBought linked1..3Name and linked1..3RetailPrice/SalesPrice; the key returns the first three links, so a product with more than three links per type would leave cards unchecked); check-hardcoded cannot see them today.

Gap (no key): the Free Shipping, WaterSense and BIO Certified badges and the remaining-highlights count ('1', RemainingHighlightsCount) depend on the linked products' highlights; PRODUCT_LINKED_PRODUCTS returns no highlights and does not constrain them. RemainingHighlightsCount stays expected-output; a fallback product's links will likely fail these checks. Proposal (not written): make the badge checks structural (badges of the linked products as returned) or add optional linkedNHighlights outputs to PRODUCT_LINKED_PRODUCTS.
Same need as the bundle/group classes' linked-products checks (PRODUCT_LINKED_PRODUCTS); no new key.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in (the CentralizedLogin group is a tag only; no login call in the method).
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); sheet SKUs were looked up read-only with bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
